Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency and cost discussion was helpful. To make the onboarding kickoff productive, Samir and I put together a quick summary of what we expect from the pilot so you can recommend a tight shortlist and sizing guidance. High level:

- Primary use case: invoice extraction + conversational Q&A over 8k-context customer docs (mixture of short receipts and longer contracts).
- Expected steady-state: ~40k user interactions / month (~1.1M tokens generated + ~900k prompt tokens).
- Peak: 2x daily peak around payroll runs (estimated 6k concurrent requests over 10-minute windows).
- Latency SLO: 350ms p50 for generation, p95 under 1.2s.

Would appreciate if you can share: model shortlist (3 candidates), recommended context length per candidate, rough monthly token cost delta, and a first-pass GPU sizing for a 6-week pilot. I attached a CSV with our sample daily token profile and a one-page pilot objectives doc.

Hi Olivia / Samir — thanks for the clear brief and the CSV. Quick response with a recommended starter plan and a few tradeoffs to consider.

Shortlist (3 candidates) — tradeoffs in latency, cost, and context handling:
1) LlamaX-13B-QUANT (8k native, 16-bit KVs): best balance for long-context Q&A, good instruction-following. Higher per-token cost than smaller alternatives but fewer rollbacks thanks to long context.
2) Mistral-7B-Long (8k native, optimized causal kernels): lower cost, lower memory; expect slightly higher p95 latency under spike. Good for extraction + structured outputs.
3) Falcon-40B-Windowed (16k segmented with KV stitching): best-quality answers for complex contracts, but requires more GPU memory and will have higher per-token expense.

Context recommendations:
- Pilot baseline: target 8k for LlamaX/Mistral; test Falcon at 12k for a subset of flows (contract summarization).
- For Q&A, use prefix caching for repeated doc queries; we can reduce average prompt tokens by ~20% based on your CSV sample.

Token cost & GPU sizing (rough):
- Monthly tokens (your CSV): ~2.0M tokens total (prompt + gen).
- Cost delta (approx monthly inference compute only):
  * LlamaX-13B-QUANT: baseline $6k–$8k/month
  * Mistral-7B-Long: baseline $3.5k–$5k/month
  * Falcon-40B: baseline $12k–$18k/month
- Pilot concurrency sizing (6-week pilot, allow 2x headroom for peaks):
  * LlamaX-13B on 2 reserved T4-equivalent instances for steady throughput; add 1 GPU for peak burst handling.
  * Mistral-7B on 1 reserved high-memory GPU with autoscale to 2 for peaks.
  * Falcon-40B requires 1x A100-80GB equivalent for pilot (segmented KV stitching increases memory).

Suggested pilot scope (6 weeks):
- Week 0–1: ingest 100 customer docs, enable prefix caching, run 2 sample flows (extraction + Q&A).
- Week 2–4: run A/B across LlamaX vs Mistral for production-like slices; measure p50/p95 and token usage.
- Week 5–6: expand Falcon tests on long-contract flows only if quality uplift justifies cost.

Next steps: I’ll loop in Grace (ops) to translate this to a concrete infra config and Monica (CS) for the implementation plan and success metrics. Can we do Mon 3/18 10:00am PT for a 30-min kickoff?

Attaching a quick pilot matrix I drafted.

Thanks,
Karthik

Looping in ops notes and the quick runbook items I’ll own for the pilot. High level items for the kickoff agenda:

- Confirm data ingestion cadence and doc sizes (we saw large outliers in the CSV; need to confirm the percentage of >6k-token docs).
- Prefix/KV caching plan: enable per-customer cache + warm caches during business hours to hit latency SLO.
- Canary routing policy: start 10% traffic to candidate model, scale to 50% after 48h with success criteria (p95 within 25% of baseline and no regressions in extraction F1).
- Monitoring & alerts: token burn dashboard, per-route p50/p95, cache hit ratio, and cost burn rate alarm (daily).
- Rollback plan: automatic fallback to Mistral-7B for sustained p95 > 1.2s for >10 minutes.

Attachment: workload_snapshot_v1.pdf (high level charts) and pilot_scope_matrix.xlsx. Dylan — please draft a short test script we can run during week 2 A/B to measure extract F1 and hallucination rate. Monica — I’ll need the onboarding success metrics you’ll commit to in the kickoff doc (CS targets).

Thanks — I’ll translate this into an infra ticket and add resource estimates (GPU hours) once we confirm sample distribution.

Grace
